title: $200K-funded fifth-dimension gravity theory report handed in

tellings.quote: I handed them a report and they said, "Thank you, Dr. Brandenburg. Here's your check. Don't let the door hit you when you go out of the building."

plain: A scientist named John Brandenburg says a government funder he does not name paid him around $200,000 to work on a theory of gravity built on a fifth dimension, and that when he handed in his report they were glad to see him go. He tells Michels they said: "Thank you, Dr. Brandenburg. Here's your check. Don't let the door hit you when you go out of the building." He tells it as a sign that the work was paid for but then set aside.
